title: Unified 24-word Farcaster recovery across WebAssembly and native
changes: Use one 24-word recovery flow: twenty-four numbered, secure, theme-styled input cells on desktop and mobile, and a fixed 24-word WebAssembly recovery sheet.
Replace the native platform checkbox with an accessible, theme-aware reveal-words control; mask secrets by default and support pasting the full phrase in sequence.
Require exactly 24 words at the browser BIP39 validator and the native Qt bridge, update translated onboarding copy and preserve zero-persistence custody handling.
